purpose: Declare one test per AC of US-19101 (FBS-222) driving rcf audit separation through bin/rcf.js over fixture git histories, so the FBS-222 Define round turns each declaration into a red test against the separation verb.
title: rcf audit separation: per-commit Hand trailer judged against touched path classes, PASS and FAIL lines, undeclared commits, bad ref and non-repo exits, --json rows, read-only and deterministic

testCases.description: rcf audit separation over test-author, builder and verifier commits on their own paths exits 0 and prints "separation: PASS 3 commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): test-author 1, builder 1, verifier 1, stage-keeper 0, neutral 0, undeclared 0, exceptions 0"
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation.test.js::AC-19101-1: rcf audit separation over test-author, builder and verifier commits on their own paths exits 0 and prints "separation: PASS 3 commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): test-author 1, builder 1, verifier 1, stage-keeper 0, neutral 0, undeclared 0, exceptions 0"

testCases.description: rcf audit separation with a Hand: builder commit touching test/x.test.js exits 4 and prints "separation: FAIL 1 of <n> commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): <sha7> Hand=builder touches test/x.test.js"
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation.test.js::AC-19101-2: rcf audit separation with a Hand: builder commit touching test/x.test.js exits 4 and prints "separation: FAIL 1 of <n> commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): <sha7> Hand=builder touches test/x.test.js"

testCases.description: rcf audit separation passes undeclared commits touching only src/ or only test/ and counts them undeclared; an undeclared commit touching both exits 4 naming both paths
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation.test.js::AC-19101-3: rcf audit separation passes undeclared commits touching only src/ or only test/ and counts them undeclared; an undeclared commit touching both exits 4 naming both paths

testCases.description: rcf audit separation --base <missing-ref> exits 2 with "separation: bad ref <ref>"; outside a git repository it exits 1 with "separation: not a git repository"; an unknown Hand value is a violation "unknown hand <value>"
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation.test.js::AC-19101-4: rcf audit separation --base <missing-ref> exits 2 with "separation: bad ref <ref>"; outside a git repository it exits 1 with "separation: not a git repository"; an unknown Hand value is a violation "unknown hand <value>"

testCases.description: rcf audit separation --json prints a JSON array of one SeparationRow { sha, subject, hand, declared, classes, verdict, reason, paths } per non-merge commit with merge commits absent
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation.test.js::AC-19101-5: rcf audit separation --json prints a JSON array of one SeparationRow { sha, subject, hand, declared, classes, verdict, reason, paths } per non-merge commit with merge commits absent

testCases.description: rcf audit separation writes no file, reads no network and no chain: two runs over the same range print byte-identical output and leave git status unchanged
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation.test.js::AC-19101-6: rcf audit separation writes no file, reads no network and no chain: two runs over the same range print byte-identical output and leave git status unchanged

testCases.description: rcf audit separation classifies a committed report under rcf/verify-reports/ as verifier evidence
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/audit-separation.test.js::AC-19101-7: rcf audit separation classifies a committed report under rcf/verify-reports/ as verifier evidence
